ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 1979
PAKISTAN BROADCASTING CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance to amend the Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th July 1979]
No. F. 17(I)/79-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 4th July 1979, is .hereby
published for general information:-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 22, Act XXXII of 1973

ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 1979
ORDINANCE XXXIII OF 1979
PAKISTAN BROADCASTING CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance to amend the Pakistan Broadcasting Corporation Act, 1973
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 5th July 1979]
No. F. 17(I)/79-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 4th July 1979, is .hereby
published for general information:-
2. Amendment of section 22, Act XXXII of 1973.-In the Pakistan
Broadcasting Corporation Act, 1973 (XXXII of 1973), section 22 shall be
renumbered as subsection (1) of that section and, after subsection (1)
renumbered as aforesaid, the following new subsection shall be added, namely.:-
"(2) The regulations made
under this section on the first occasion, other than those having financial
implications, may be made so as to have effect from the date of the
establishment of the Corporation.".
